snippet.title: Smash Out ZX Spectrum
snippet.description: While there wasn't a lot of Amidar clones on the ZX Spectrum there were quite a large number of breakout clones.  Of course there was Arkanoid and Arkanoid 2, there was Batty, who can possibly forget Baloon-Man, the slowest breakout game in the world, and now I present Smash-Out which is far below the standards set by Batty and the Arkanoids, the ball moves too fast, your bat is too slow, work out what happens.  Pirate Software released a lot of tripe and this is no exception!
